note: This file is an MMDetection configuration dictionary with no callable Python code. It inherits from faster-rcnn_r50_fpn_1x_coco.py and overrides the roi_head to use DoubleHeadRoIHead with a DoubleConvFCBBoxHead. No functions, classes, or CLI entry points are defined.
summarize_config: summarize the MMDetection config for Double Head Faster R-CNN with ResNet-50 FPN on COCO
review_model_config: review the DoubleHeadRoIHead and DoubleConvFCBBoxHead model configuration settings
build_detection_model: build a detection model using the Double Head Faster R-CNN config with 80 COCO classes
test_bbox_head: test the DoubleConvFCBBoxHead with 4 conv layers and 2 FC layers for bounding box regression
refactor_loss_weights: refactor the CrossEntropyLoss and SmoothL1Loss weight settings in the bbox head config
